description: Fetch the result of a convert_document job. Returns { markdown, preview, pages, source_format, size_original, size_markdown, truncated, extraction_truncated, extraction_notice }. `source_format` is what the magic bytes said, not what you declared. `truncated` true means what you are holding is not the whole document — checking it alone is always safe, it is never false while content is missing. Three causes, NOT equally recoverable: full_text was false (re-ask with full_text=true); the body exceeded the inline limit and `storage_key` holds the rest — GET /api/v1/jobs/spiderConvert/{job_id}/content returns it as text/markdown; or `extraction_truncated` is also true, meaning the PARSER stopped early — at 100 pages, or at 100 CSV rows. That text was never produced, so there is nothing to fetch and re-uploading will not help; split the document instead. `extraction_notice` says which limit was hit. `pages` counts pages EXTRACTED, so when extraction_truncated is true the document has at least that many and probably more.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: get_conversion
